title: GLASS Terminal
body: The terminal is the camera. It looks towards where you stood when you placed it (place it from above or below to make it look down or up).
Right-click it to make a [[channels|channel]] with this terminal as its camera: give the channel a name and a password. A channel has one camera; the owner can move it to another terminal later.
Breaking the terminal takes the channel's camera offline, but the channel itself stays. It is as tough as obsidian.
